title: arctium umbrosum
intro: Arctium umbrosum, commonly known as prickly burdock or lesser burdock, is a biennial herbaceous plant in the sunflower family (Asteraceae). It has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, including reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and boosting the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Arctium umbrosum are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which are thought to be mediated by its bioactive constituents, including arctigenin, luteolin, and caffeic acid. The plant's bioactive constituents may also contribute to its potential in treating various conditions, such as arthritis, ulcers, and skin infections.
